Check the last time metadata was updated

Source: R/metadata_utils.R
nc_metadata_version.Rd

Some metadata is stored locally and can be updated with nc_metadata(). Use nc_metadata_version() to see when these files were last updated.

Usage

nc_metadata_version()

Value

Date of the last update

Details

Metadata stored locally - use nc_metadata() to update

  • meta_country_codes()

  • meta_statprov_codes()

  • meta_subnational2_codes()

  • meta_iba_codes()

  • meta_bcr_codes()

  • meta_utm_squares() - use nc_metadata(utm = TRUE) to update (big update)

  • meta_species_authority()

  • meta_species_codes()

  • meta_species_taxonomy()

Examples

nc_metadata_version()
#> metadata_updated 
#>     "2026-06-05"
